what_it_is.prose: SatSure is a Bengaluru-based deep-tech decision intelligence company founded on 6 May 2017 by Prateep Basu (CEO), Abhishek Raju, Rashmit Singh Sukhmani and Ishan Tomar. Leverages satellite imagery, aerial data, IoT inputs and machine learning to deliver actionable insights for agriculture, banking, infrastructure and sustainability. Key products: SatSure SPARTA (crop lifecycle monitoring — crop health, yield estimation, damage assessment); SatSure INSURANCE (EO-powered crop risk modelling, yield forecasts, claim validation for insurers/reinsurers). Major partnership with Reliance General Insurance (Oct 2020) for satellite-based crop monitoring. Subsidiary KaleidEO operates in upstream EO segment (Jan 2026 partnership announcement). Operates in India and globally (Swiss office). Recognised by India AI, FAO, ADB Ventures. Backed by Series A funding.
